notes: This source/test traceability contract covers the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Unsubscribe Interaction Class service in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The declaration transition removes ordinary interaction delivery eligibility for the invoking federate. Its focused production-filesystem regression adds the successful-void service-report boundary: an invalid class appends nothing, while an accepted unsubscription appends its type-27 InteractionClassHandle argument before any separately queued declaration advisories. The §5.11 service has no ordinary-subscription precondition, so the regression uses the accepted idempotent removal path to isolate that report boundary. The Requirements Lab currently assigns this service-level candidate on its coalesced source page to clause-5.11.3; RL-078 records that ownership mismatch while the service/test descriptions retain the direct §5.11 source context. Timestamped interaction behavior, advisory delivery matrices, MOM interaction delivery, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
